name: pixlens
description: See images in Claude Code: thumbnails of what you paste and previews of what tools read or make; click one to open it in your image viewer

binary.title: pixlens CLI
binary.description: Path to the pixlens binary; a bare name is looked up on PATH

mode.title: Drawing
mode.description: image: real pixels (kitty, Ghostty); blocks: colored half-blocks (any terminal); auto: pick by terminal

glyphs.title: Block glyphs
glyphs.description: quad: four dots a cell, the sharpest; half: two dots a cell, for fonts that draw quadrants with gaps

maxColumns.title: Widest preview, in columns
maxColumns.description: Previews are scaled down to fit this many terminal columns

maxRows.title: Tallest preview, in rows
maxRows.description: Previews are scaled down to fit this many terminal rows

thumbRows.title: Paste thumbnail height, in rows
thumbRows.description: Thumbnails above the prompt are scaled down to fit this many rows

automatic.title: Preview images that tools read or make
automatic.description: Draw an image under a Read, Write or Edit of an image file, and under a Bash command that writes one

pasteThumbnails.title: Thumbnails of pasted images
pasteThumbnails.description: Show the images you paste as thumbnails above the prompt until you send it

overlay.title: Sharp pictures in Apple's Terminal
overlay.description: On macOS, start Pixlens Overlay (shipped in this plugin) to lay the real picture over each preview. Needs Accessibility access for your terminal

tool.title: Give Claude the image_preview tool
tool.description: Registers image_preview, which Claude calls to show you an image without reading it itself
